description: The numbers the provider's own opt-out handling has blocked after they texted STOP. Telnyx publishes this list (by messaging profile); Twilio does not (a send to such a number comes back as Twilio error 21610), and the answer says so. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: list_provider_opt_outs
title: List the provider's opt-outs
